initial_parallel_mission.objective: Expand deterministic strategy families and directional variants.

Implement preregistered multi-horizon time-series momentum/trend candidates: past-return sign, moving-average crossover, channel breakout and volatility-scaled trend. Keep LONG/SHORT and ES/NQ/YM/RTY separate; no parameter optimization.
Implement deterministic regime-switch candidate that chooses trend, mean-reversion or NO_TRADE from causal volatility, bandwidth, directional-efficiency, VWAP-distance/slope and session features.
Implement NQ volatility-conditioned mean-reversion candidate using displacement measured in volatility units, with separate LONG and SHORT variants and no hand-tuned point thresholds.
Search compatible LONG and SHORT coalitions by context.
Run train/validation/OOS and compare coalitions against individual baselines.

Backtest R1-R4 independently against frozen baselines using next-bar execution, realistic costs and separate instrument/direction/timeframe reporting. One-day Databento sample is mechanics-only and cannot support promotion.
Run Monte Carlo, cost, missed-trade, parameter and coalition-dropout stress.
Attempt to falsify R1-R4 with parameter perturbation, cost/slippage/latency stress, trade dropout, block bootstrap/Monte Carlo, year/regime/instrument/direction splits and minimum-sample gates.
Register every trial and compute DSR/PBO before any research promotion.
Record every R1-R4 parameterization including failures; prohibit cherry-picking and require CSCV/PBO plus Deflated Sharpe before promotion.
Rank coalitions by payout and account-survival probability under prop-firm profiles.
Define point-in-time macro/event features and veto interface.
Build MBP/MBO liquidity, absorption, stacking/pulling and queue-pressure features.
Fuse market/order-flow state with point-in-time finance-news embeddings using causal cross-attention in shadow mode.

Admit robust technical experts/context only after screening; compare technical-only, news-only, simple concatenation, equal-weight ensemble and cross-attention OOS. Reject cross-attention if it adds no stable incremental value.
Audit timestamp, gaps, symbol mapping, costs and no-lookahead assumptions.
Verify multi-year point-in-time historical coverage, rolls, sessions and realistic costs before any robustness conclusion; mark the 2026-09-11 one-day Databento fixture as mechanics-only.
